vscode.smith-version.this-workspace-has-: This workspace has its own smith, which is not used because the workspace is not trusted.
vscode.smith-version.a-terminal-runs-smi: A terminal runs smith {terminalVersion} from the PATH.
vscode.smith-version.monosmith-runs-smit: MonoSmith runs smith {editorVersion} from {sourceName}, but a terminal here runs smith {terminalVersion} from the PATH. Results can differ.
